name: WF-061 AI Assistant Tool Dispatch & Receipt Gate

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const norm=v=>String(v??'').trim(); const lower=v=>norm(v).toLowerCase(); const routes={portfolio_snapshot:'wf-045-portfolio-performance',lead_lookup:'insula-crm-lead-lookup',lead_followup_queue:'wf-059-operating-queue',deal_lookup:'wf-051-unified-operational-control-plane',deal_underwrite:'wf-034-acquisition-decision-gate',buyer_match:'wf-038-buyer-matching',pipeline_status:'wf-046-acquisition-pipeline-orchestration',production_health:'wf-047-production-readiness',approval_status:'wf-052-human-approval-authorization',crm_activity:'insula-crm-activities',send_offer:'wf-036-offer-lifecycle',contact_seller:'wf-036-offer-lifecycle',contact_buyer:'wf-039-buyer-disposition-response',prepare_contract:'wf-041-transaction-tracking',schedule_closing:'wf-042-closing-coordination'}; const readOnly=new Set(['portfolio_snapshot','lead_lookup','lead_followup_queue','deal_lookup','deal_underwrite','buyer_match','pipeline_status','production_health','approval_status']); const risky=new Set(['send_offer','contact_seller','contact_buyer','prepare_contract','schedule_closing']); const intent=lower(input.interpreted_intent??input.intent); const requestId=norm(input.request_id??input.requestId); const suppliedKey=norm(input.idempotency_key); const canonical=norm(input.lead_id??input.property_id??input.deal_id??input.candidate_key); const version=norm(input.version??'1'); const idempotencyKey=suppliedKey||['ai-assistant',intent,canonical||'scope',version].join(':'); const blockers=[]; if(!requestId)blockers.push({type:'missing_request_id',severity:'blocking'}); if(!intent||!routes[intent])blockers.push({type:'unsupported_intent',severity:'blocking',intent:intent||null}); if(!canonical&&!['portfolio_snapshot','lead_followup_queue','pipeline_status','production_health','approval_status'].includes(intent))blockers.push({type:'missing_canonical_identity',severity:'blocking',intent}); const approvalState=lower(input.approval_state??input.authorization_state); const authorized=risky.has(intent)&&approvalState==='approved'; const dispatchAllowed=blockers.length===0&&(readOnly.has(intent)||authorized); const actionType=risky.has(intent)?'external_side_effect':'read_only'; const envelope={request_id:requestId||null,idempotency_key:idempotencyKey,intent,workflow_route:routes[intent]||null,action_type:actionType,canonical_identity:canonical||null,authorization:{required:risky.has(intent),state:approvalState||'not_required',authorized},dispatch_allowed:dispatchAllowed,dispatch_status:dispatchAllowed?'queued':'blocked',receipt_required:true,execution_contract:{request_id:requestId||null,idempotency_key:idempotencyKey,workflow_route:routes[intent]||null,canonical_identity:canonical||null},blockers,next_action:dispatchAllowed?'Dispatch through the mapped workflow and persist its execution receipt through WF-055/WF-056.':blockers.length?'Resolve the blocking request-contract fields before dispatch.': 'Obtain explicit human approval in WF-052 before dispatching this external-side-effect action.',policy:{read_only_by_default:true,approved_side_effect_only:true,no_automatic_external_action_without_approval:true,deterministic_idempotency:true,receipt_required:true,no_legal_validation:true,no_title_clearance_claim:true,no_funding_verification_claim:true}}; return[{json:envelope}];
